description: Interactive conductor-insulator testing circuit tool with MCQ quiz for Grade 7 Science (NCERT Ch 3, Section 3.4). Practice mode has two sub-tabs: Circuit Test (drag-and-drop predict-then-test) and MCQ Quiz (10 NCERT-aligned multiple-choice questions with difficulty levels, explanations, scoring, and results screen).
subject: Science
chapter: Chapter 3 - Electricity: Circuits and their Components

learn.description: Guided drag-and-drop circuit testing with instant feedback and explanations.

subTabs.circuit: Predict-then-test: Tap a material, predict conductor/insulator, then see the circuit result. Scored.
subTabs.mcq: 10 multiple-choice questions covering classification, concepts, safety, and applications. Each question has 4 options, difficulty tag (easy/medium/hard), detailed explanation after answering, and a final results screen with score ring and grade.

real_world.description: Carousel of 5 everyday objects showing conductor and insulator parts.

features: A/B/C/D option labels with colored badges
Correct answer: green pulse animation + checkmark
Wrong answer: red shake animation + X icon
Detailed explanation card after each answer
Final results: score ring SVG, percentage, grade message, retry button

teachingNotes: Practice mode now has MCQ Quiz alongside Circuit Test. Students should complete Learn mode first, then use Circuit Test to build intuition, and MCQ Quiz to test conceptual understanding. The 10 questions cover easy→hard difficulty and test not just classification but reasoning (why wires have plastic, why electricians wear rubber).
